snippet.title: Dev Team Reads Player Comments (Pray for Us) | What's Next | Global Relaunch | Farlight 84
snippet.description:
The wait is over—Farlight 84’s biggest summer update is scheduled on August 7! Global relaunch, free Battle Pass, new FPP mode, hero, weapon, map, and more. 

In this special patch note video, Chance, on behalf of the Farlight 84 team, takes on real player comments from the community. What’s he about to face? Praise? Complaints? Chaos? There’s only one way to find out…

Timestamps:
00:00 Intro
07:10 FPP Gameplay Details
08:48 New Map: Nextara 
09:49 Game Modes Overview
10:35 Jetpack Royale Mode 
11:13 Endless Respawn Mode 
11:38 New Hero: Kui Dou 
12:05 Syfer Revamp & Abilities
14:20 New Buddies 
16:16 Weapon Updates & Attachments
18:18 Tactical Equipment
19:42 New Season & Skins


#Farlight84 #PatchNotes #GlobalRelaunch #JetpackReturns

ABOUT FARLIGHT 84

In Farlight 84, you get to play as heroes with unique skills to outsmart your enemies, unleashing special abilities to catch them off guard... AND you get to collect adorable Buddies to join you as loyal companions in battle. Buddy up, it’s time to Battle Royale!
